analytical_dimensions.description: An existing school the person fits
probing_questions: Which school in the packet does the person's use in the oeuvre place them in, on what evidence?

analytical_dimensions.description: A new school proposed around the person
probing_questions: If no listed school fits, what school would this person anchor, and which persons cited alongside them belong to it?
Fits a listed school, anchors a new one, or not a candidate for the Referee at all?

problematique: A person the author cites whom the Referee does not know: read how the oeuvre cites them (as evidence, as an opponent, as a source, in which debates, beside whom) and say where they belong — an existing school of thought in the Referee, or a new school proposed around them with candidate members drawn from the persons cited alongside, or no candidate at all (an editor, a translator, a name in passing). Only persons the packet lists as unknown; only schools the packet lists; only candidates the oeuvre actually cites.
researcher_question: Which school of thought would this cited person fit, or which new school should be proposed around them?
